citations.H40.1130: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting FY2027, Section I.C.7.a.5: the seventh character 0, unspecified, is assigned when there is no documentation regarding the stage of the glaucoma; the seventh character 4 is for glaucoma whose stage cannot be clinically determined. Section I.C.7.a.2: when both eyes are documented as the same type and stage and a code for bilateral glaucoma exists, only the bilateral code is reported. Here the provider documents primary open-angle glaucoma of both eyes and states no stage; the optic nerve and visual field findings are recorded but the provider does not name a stage from them, so the bilateral code is reported with the seventh character 0.

coder_notes: The visual field findings would fit a severe stage clinically, but the stage has to be documented by the provider; a coder does not derive it from the findings. The visual field defects are part of the glaucoma and are not coded separately. In practice this documentation would lead to a provider query; the gold is what can be reported from the note as written.
